# Ethereum.org

> The complete guide to Ethereum, covering the protocol, cryptocurrency, smart contracts, DeFi, NFTs, Layer 2 scaling, and the broader Web3 ecosystem.

Ethereum.org serves as the official educational and reference hub for the Ethereum blockchain, providing resources for beginners, developers, and institutions. The site aggregates information on Ethereum's technology, use cases, tools, and applications across DeFi, NFTs, staking, and institutional adoption.

## Key Topics

- Ethereum
- Smart Contracts
- DeFi (Decentralized Finance)
- Layer 2 Scaling
- ETH (Ether)
- NFTs
- Wallets
- Staking
- Web3
- Stablecoins
- DAOs
- Uniswap
- Aave
- Getting Started
- Developer Resources

## Getting Started

- [Ethereum.org: The complete guide to Ethereum](https://ethereum.org): Main homepage introducing Ethereum platform, cryptocurrency, and ecosystem
- [What is Ethereum? (A Complete Guide)](https://ethereum.org/what-is-ethereum): Comprehensive overview of Ethereum, smart contracts, and ecosystem basics
- [What is Ether (ETH)? (A complete guide)](https://ethereum.org/what-is-ether): Complete guide to ETH cryptocurrency: uses, buying, staking, pricing
- [Ethereum guides](https://ethereum.org/guides): Collection of beginner guides covering wallets, security, Layer 2, tokens

## Developer Resources

- [Ethereum Developer Resources](https://ethereum.org/developers): Developer documentation, tutorials, tools for building on Ethereum
- [Ethereum Whitepaper](https://ethereum.org/whitepaper): Original technical whitepaper by Buterin defining Ethereum vision
- [Ethereum roadmap](https://ethereum.org/roadmap): Technical roadmap for Ethereum upgrades and future development
- [Dashboard of Ethereum Resources](https://ethereum.org/resources): Curated dashboard of ecosystem tools, analytics, and block explorers

## Using Ethereum

- [Ethereum wallets: Buy, Store and Send crypto](https://ethereum.org/wallets): Guide to Ethereum wallet types, security, and account management
- [How to buy Ethereum (ETH)](https://ethereum.org/get-eth): Guide to purchasing ETH via exchanges, DEXs, and payment methods
- [What is DeFi? | Benefits and Use of Decentralised Finance](https://ethereum.org/defi): Introduction to DeFi on Ethereum and financial applications
- [Stablecoins explained: What are they for?](https://ethereum.org/stablecoins): Guide to stablecoins on Ethereum: types, uses, and examples

## Ethereum Applications & Ecosystem

- [Top crypto apps on Ethereum](https://ethereum.org/apps): Directory of DeFi, NFT, gaming, and Web3 applications on Ethereum
- [What are NFTs? | Benefits and use](https://ethereum.org/nft): Overview of NFTs on Ethereum and use cases for digital assets
- [Intro to Ethereum Layer 2: benefits and uses](https://ethereum.org/layer-2): Guide to Layer 2 scaling solutions and rollup technologies
- [Ethereum for Institutions | The Institutional Liquidity Layer](https://institutions.ethereum.org): Enterprise-focused resource on institutional adoption and use cases

## Featured Applications

- [Ethereum Apps - Fluid](https://ethereum.org/apps/fluid): DeFi protocol by Instadapp with liquidity, lending, and DEX features
- [Ethereum Apps - Highlight](https://ethereum.org/apps/highlight): Platform for creating and collecting digital art and NFTs
- [Ethereum Apps - ResearchHub](https://ethereum.org/apps/researchhub): DAO platform accelerating scientific research collaboration
